title: PostgreSQL settings
description: Superuser password and the few server settings a PostgreSQL instance exposes.

superuserPassword.title: Superuser password
superuserPassword.description: Password of the postgres superuser, set once when the cluster is created.

maxConnections.title: Max connections
maxConnections.description: Most client connections the server accepts at once.

sharedBuffersMb.title: Shared buffers (MB)
sharedBuffersMb.description: Memory the server reserves for caching data pages.

logStatement.title: Log statements
logStatement.description: Which SQL statements are written to the instance log. Statements that set passwords are logged as typed.

logMinDurationStatementMs.title: Log slow statements (ms)
logMinDurationStatementMs.description: Log every statement that runs at least this long; -1 turns it off.
